notes: head is the commit the reviewer sees; base is its parent unless given. seed cases apply seeds/<id>.patch on top of head. Defect text is for the judge only and never reaches the reviewer. author is the model family that wrote the change (Claude-Session trailers, or a codex/ head branch).

defects.text: Codex device sign-in is started from the Worker (server side) against OpenAI's device-authorization endpoints; in production it fails before a code is shown, and the Mac UI replaces the real sign-in error with a generic expired-login message.

Making the queue-runner cases concurrent leaves the 'turn deferred while the tempod socket is down' case racy: the fake tempod can reconnect before the deferred state is asserted, so the test is nondeterministic.

The terminal WebSocket server side never sets binaryType = 'arraybuffer'; in workerd binary keyboard frames arrive as Blob objects, which are passed to the PTY stdin as bytes, so typed input never reaches the shell.

Branch tips are read with repo.log({ ref: 'refs/heads/<branch>' }); the real Artifacts binding resolves only branch names, tags or commit IDs and returns no commits for full ref names, so every native PR create/merge/CI head check sees the branch as missing. The test fakes strip refs/heads/ and hide this.
COPY --chmod=0644 creates /opt/tempo and /opt/tempo/pi with mode 0644 (no execute bit), so the non-root tempo user cannot traverse the directories and cannot load the Pi profile.

list_issue_labels has an empty input struct; Effect renders it as {"not":{"type":"null"}} instead of an object schema, and Claude Code rejects the whole MCP tools/list (inputSchema.type must be object), so Claude sessions lose all tempo tools.
The issue comments pagination test runs findByRole over a 50-comment page with a 1 s budget; on a loaded runner it times out (nondeterministic test).
The forge demo e2e test matches '# fail 0' and '# pass N', which is TAP output; Node 24's default spec reporter prints 'ℹ fail 0', so the assertion fails on the real image.

The 'runs one op at a time, in creation order' case is now concurrent but still uses sleep(300) in the fake commit handler and asserts state during that window and a >=250 ms timing; under load the ordering assertions race.

The failed-unlink test uses vi.spyOn(env.DATA, 'put').mockRejectedValueOnce(...) on a shared binding while other cases run concurrently, so the one rejection can be consumed by an unrelated put (nondeterministic test).

The protected-file guard calls Files.readFile and treats status 404 as absent, but the Sandbox SDK throws SandboxFileError ENOENT for a missing file, so for an owner without a Codex login every run fails to start (AGENT_START_FAILED).

cases.head: f1b8a67
cases.author: claude
cases.message:
Treat unreadable login files as absent

A login the owner never set up must not block a run.

defects.text: Any readFile failure (not only ENOENT) now counts as an absent file, so an unreadable or tampered protected login file no longer fails the run with RUN_ACCESS_VIOLATION: the guard fails open.

cases.head: f1b8a67
cases.author: claude
cases.message:
Let skipped jobs satisfy the merge gate

A job skipped by needs should not hold a merge.

defects.text: The merge gate accepts a required job with conclusion 'skipped'; a required job is skipped when one of its needs failed, so a PR whose lint failed can merge. Tab 10 requires every required job to be 'success'.

cases.head: f1b8a67
cases.author: claude
cases.message: Log Artifacts token issue for debugging expired clones

defects.text: The repository token plaintext is interpolated into the log message string. log() redacts only fields whose names look secret, not the message, so the token reaches the Worker log. Rule 9: never put a secret in logs.

prepareArtifactMerge no longer returns the recorded merge for an already merged PR; a retry after a lost acknowledgement now fails with PR_NOT_MERGEABLE instead of reconciling the pushed result (tab 09 merge retry rule, rule 5 idempotent steps).

cases.head: f1b8a67
cases.author: claude
cases.message: Speed up the run fixture's prompt wait

defects.text: The run test helper replaces waitFor on the observable session.prompt request with a fixed 200 ms sleep; tests become nondeterministic under load (repo rule: wait for observable state instead of sleeping).

cases.head: f1b8a67
cases.author: claude
cases.message: Tighten Pi profile permissions in the image

defects.text: The Pi profile becomes root-owned mode 0600, so the non-root tempo user that runs Pi cannot read it.

cases.head: f1b8a67
cases.author: claude
cases.message: Advance issue tool pagination past the last returned item

defects.text: nextOffset adds 1 to offset + returned count, so following nextOffset skips one issue or comment per page.

cases.head: f1b8a67
cases.author: claude
cases.message: Reuse public project lookup in issue handlers

defects.text: Issue handlers now accept any public project, including create, update and delete, so any signed-in visitor can change or delete issues of another owner's public project (tab 11 visitors may only read).
